LanguageData.LP_WL_EldritchBlast.label: eldritch blast
LanguageData.LP_WL_EldritchBlast.description: Cantrip: fire eldritch beams at enemies within 24 cells, each 10 × pact power force damage; 2 / 3 / 4 beams at warlock levels 5 / 10 / 15. If the target falls, the remaining beams hit another enemy within 6 cells. Costs no pact mana. Warlock level 1.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Darkness.label: darkness
LanguageData.LP_WL_Darkness.description: Call magical darkness of radius 3 at a point within 20 cells: enemies inside get sight -50% for 10 seconds × pact power. Costs 1 pact mana, cooldown 20 seconds. Warlock level 3.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Invocations.label: eldritch invocations
LanguageData.LP_WL_Invocations.description: Passive: choose one invocation each at warlock levels 5 and 9 (permanent, and you can't pick the same one twice): Agonizing Blast (each eldritch blast beam + Charisma modifier × 2 damage, at least +2), Devil's Sight (sight in darkness +30%, unaffected by magical darkness), Eldritch Spear (Eldritch Blast range 24 → 36 cells). Warlock level 5.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Hex.label: hex
LanguageData.LP_WL_Hex.description: Hex one enemy within 24 cells for 60 seconds × pact power: damage it takes from you ×1.25, success of all its saves (mind resistance, ability saves) -15%. Costs 1 pact mana, cooldown 10 seconds. Warlock level 7.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Dominate.label: mystic arcanum: dominate person
LanguageData.LP_WL_Dominate.description: Seize the mind of one hostile humanlike within 20 cells (resisted by mind resistance; Hex makes it harder to resist): if it fails, it goes berserk and attacks those nearby for 15 seconds × pact power. Story bosses and legendary units have a 50% chance to break free. Costs no pact mana, once per day. Warlock level 11.
LanguageData.LP_WL_ForceCage.label: mystic arcanum: forcecage
LanguageData.LP_WL_ForceCage.description: Raise a forcecage at a point within 20 cells: enemies within radius 2 are locked in for 10 seconds × pact power (stunned, damage taken ×0.5); half the time for story bosses and legendary units. Costs no pact mana, once per day. Warlock level 13.
LanguageData.LP_WL_EldritchMaster.label: eldritch master
LanguageData.LP_WL_EldritchMaster.description: Entreat your patron for 10 seconds (cannot move while casting) to fully restore pact mana at once. Once per day. Warlock level 15, also requires Social 15.
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkBlessing.label: dark one's blessing
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkBlessing.description: Passive: killing an enemy heals yourself 5 + warlock level / 2 injury. Fiend patron, warlock level 1.
LanguageData.LP_WL_HellishRebuke.label: infernal rebuke
LanguageData.LP_WL_HellishRebuke.description: Engulf one enemy within 15 cells in hellfire: 15 × pact power fire damage and ignites it. Costs 1 pact mana, cooldown 10 seconds. Fiend patron, warlock level 3.
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkLuck.label: dark one's own luck
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkLuck.description: Passive: mind resistance +10%, damage taken ×0.9. Fiend patron, warlock level 7.
LanguageData.LP_WL_FiendResilience.label: fiendish resilience
LanguageData.LP_WL_FiendResilience.description: Passive: fire and burn damage taken ×0.5. Fiend patron, warlock level 11.
LanguageData.LP_WL_HurlHell.label: hurl through hell
LanguageData.LP_WL_HurlHell.description: Hurl one enemy within 20 cells into the Nine Hells for a moment: 45 × pact power fire damage, stunned for 5 seconds and shaken for 10 seconds. Costs 1 pact mana, once per day. Fiend patron, warlock level 15.
LanguageData.LP_WL_FeyPresence.label: fey presence
LanguageData.LP_WL_FeyPresence.description: Exude fey majesty: enemies within radius 4 resist with mind resistance; those who fail flee in terror for 3 seconds × pact power (those who can't flee are shaken). Costs 1 pact mana, cooldown 30 seconds. Archfey patron, warlock level 1.
LanguageData.LP_WL_MistyEscape.label: misty escape
LanguageData.LP_WL_MistyEscape.description: Turn into fey mist and teleport to an empty cell in sight within 8 cells. Costs 1 pact mana, cooldown 15 seconds. Archfey patron, warlock level 3.
LanguageData.LP_WL_BeguilingDefense.label: beguiling defenses
LanguageData.LP_WL_BeguilingDefense.description: Passive: mind resistance +30%; enemies that hit you in melee have a 20% chance to be beguiled (stunned 2 seconds). Archfey patron, warlock level 7.
LanguageData.LP_WL_Beguile.label: bewitching dance
LanguageData.LP_WL_Beguile.description: Hostile humanlikes in radius 3 at a point within 20 cells each resist with mind resistance; those who fail are charmed and wander in a daze for 15 seconds × pact power. Costs 2 pact mana, cooldown 1 hour. Archfey patron, warlock level 11.
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkDelirium.label: dark delirium
LanguageData.LP_WL_DarkDelirium.description: Drag one enemy within 20 cells into a fey illusion (resisted by mind resistance): if it fails, it flees in terror for 20 seconds × pact power and is shaken; story bosses and legendary units are only shaken. Costs 2 pact mana, cooldown 1 day. Archfey patron, warlock level 15.
LanguageData.LP_WL_AwakenedMind.label: awakened mind
LanguageData.LP_WL_AwakenedMind.description: Passive: psychic sensitivity +20%, mind resistance +10% (others' psychic control takes hold less easily and lasts shorter). Great Old One patron, warlock level 1.
LanguageData.LP_WL_DissonantWhispers.label: dissonant whispers
LanguageData.LP_WL_DissonantWhispers.description: Whisper words only it understands to one enemy within 20 cells: 14 × pact power psychic damage; if it fails to resist (mind resistance) it also flees in terror for 3 seconds. Costs 1 pact mana, cooldown 10 seconds. Great Old One patron, warlock level 3.
LanguageData.LP_WL_EntropicWard.label: entropic ward
LanguageData.LP_WL_EntropicWard.description: Passive: ranged damage taken ×0.85. Great Old One patron, warlock level 7.
LanguageData.LP_WL_ThoughtShield.label: thought shield
LanguageData.LP_WL_ThoughtShield.description: Passive: mind resistance +20%, psychic damage taken ×0.5. Great Old One patron, warlock level 11.
LanguageData.LP_WL_CreateThrall.label: create thrall
LanguageData.LP_WL_CreateThrall.description: Turn a downed hostile humanlike within 3 cells into your thrall (resisted by mind resistance; not story bosses or legendary units): if it fails, it joins your side. Costs 2 pact mana, cooldown 1 day. Great Old One patron, warlock level 15.
LanguageData.LP_LegPatronAvatar.label: patron's avatar
LanguageData.LP_LegPatronAvatar.description: Legendary: for 60 seconds the patron lends you its power; warlock abilities cost no pact mana and have ×1.5 power. Costs 3 pact mana, cooldown 2 days. Legendary warlock.
LanguageData.LP_LegEldritchSoul.label: eldritch soul
LanguageData.LP_LegEldritchSoul.description: Legendary passive: Eldritch Blast gets one more beam; killing an enemy gives +1 pact mana. Legendary warlock.
